title: Roadkill
description: The guys scrounge their parts piles and come up with impressive results.

title: Roadkill
description: Freiburger and Dulcich settle who has the better cheap 4x4.

title: Roadkill
description: The guys have a build off and race like no other; Tony transforms a shell of an '85 Monte Carlo into a beast, while Finnegan makes Newbern's Nova run with ramp truck parts; it's three days of wrenching, two tracks and one unbelievable race.

title: Roadkill
description: Mike Finnegan and David Newbern rescue a mint '67 Pontiac Firebird that has been stowed in a barn for almost two decades; the guys battle old parts, downpours and other issues in order to get this old drag car racing down the track once again.

title: Roadkill
description: Freiburger and Dulcich hit the road in the '68 Wreck Runner, a four-speed, 383ci clone made from the scraps of a '68 Road Runner and a '68 Satellite; it only has a few little issues; they hit the road to sort 'em out.

title: Roadkill
description: Finnegan and Newbern take the barn-find '67 Firebird on an 800-mile road trip to race Freiburger and Dulcich in the Crusher Camaro.

title: Roadkill
description: Freiburger and Finnegan race Dulcich and Newbern in a dirt-track shootout.

title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
description: The guys try their hand at no-prep drag racing against Lyle Barnett and his turbocharged 1,500-hp Beer Money Mustang.

title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
description: For years, Pigpen, the junkyard rescued 1950 GMC truck, has sat dormant; the guys awaken a monster by donating the chassis of their own legendary 1985 S-15 in a body swap for the ages, then take on Randy Pobst at Atlanta Motor Speedway.

title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
description: Everyone wants their car to be better, faster, stronger, but a difference is hard to make on a budget; David Newbern and Mike Cotten may not have all the answers, but they're willing to give it a run by mixing affordable upgrades with sweat equity.

title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
description: The guys uncover a cop car racing series around the Ford Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor; with a handful of bolt-on upgrades, they turn their former police auction find into a road race ripper around Willow Springs.

title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
description: The guys take on off-road Baja legend Cameron Steele on a brutal desert off-road course with a Baja Bug; they may be outmatched by Cameron's unlimited racing rig, but the addition of a 350 V-8 to their Bug closes a big gap.

title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
description: The guys take their V-8-powered Pontiac Fiero-based Lamborghini Countach kit car known as the Scamborghini and give it a 6-foot lift to take on an insane wheelie-popping mud truck through what's known as a bounty hole.

title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
description: The guys take a big-block '57 Bel Air to compete in the autocross at Cruisin' the Coast in Miss.; with a complete overhaul of the suspension in the event's parking lot, the guys find out how much lap time they can shave in a weekend.

title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
description: Off-road legend Cameron Steele warned the guys that a V-8 swap wouldn't cut as much time as a long-travel suspension could; now Newbern and Cotten finally heed his advice, going all-out with major suspension upgrades to their Baja-inspired VW Beetle.

title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
description: The guys take on Clay Millican by transforming a Model A from the ground up; with a new chassis, suspension and fresh 400-hp 347ci V-8, the Ford is improved in every way.

title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
description: Newbern and Cotten discover a gem which is not a typical American muscle with a turbocharged Eagle Talon; Shea Seefeldt challenges the guys on a rally course with his LS-swapped Subaru.

title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
description: Newbern surprises Cotten with a mint 1984 G-body and an '80s-style, stock-car-inspired build to take on an actual former cup car around the circle track.

title: Faster With Newbern And Cotten
description: Cotten's Pro Street big-block 1980 Dodge Mirada's engine dies on Roadkill; things don't go as planned as the guys attempt to add a giant blower and bigger tires, and bring the car back to its 1990s-era glory.

title: Faster With Finnegan
description: The guys transform a '73 Opel funny car into a dirt-roosting machine.

title: Faster With Finnegan
description: The dream of long travel suspension on Roadkill's slightly modified Vette Kart finally comes true for the guys; Brad DeBerti helps them figure out how to not taco the front end as they take on a Pro2 truck on an off-road short course.

title: Faster With Finnegan
description: Newbern, Cotten, and Finnegan participate in an unusual race that requires their boat to survive the competitors' attacks on a dirt track.

title: Faster With Finnegan
description: Newbern and Cotten surprise Finnegan with a 2.3L 1980 Pinto wagon and drift lessons from pro Formula Drift driver Federico Sceriffo; they add a 396ci stroker engine and suspension mods before taking on a 1,000-plus-hp Ferrari 599 GTB.

title: Faster With Finnegan
description: Finnegan, Newbern and Cotten do some wheelie R&D to find out what it takes to put a 1978 GMC Class C motorhome's tires in the air; with the help of pro wheelstander Mike Mantel, the guys take on the challenge of making dreams become reality.

title: Faster With Finnegan
description: The '78 GMC motorhome takes on Mike Mantel's Little Red Firetruck.

title: Iron Resurrection
description: It takes a lot to faze Joe Martin, but when his next job pulls into MSB it looks more like a truck load of spare parts than a 1970 C10; Joe knows exactly what he wants to do; new frame, running gear, and a supercharged LSA engine.

title: Iron Resurrection
description: Gary Hopper, a longtime friend of Joe, brings a '55 Chevy Bel Air to the shop; because this '55 has sentimental value to Gary's family, the pressure is on to do this build right; but missing pieces and a dented hood throw a wrench into the job.

title: Iron Resurrection
description: Joe Martin is excited to see a straight '63 Impala with a four speed and legendary 409 engine under the hood; the owner wants to keep it original with the main mods under the body, new frame, suspension and big wheels.

title: Iron Resurrection
description: A new customer, comes into the shop with an exceptional 1963 Cadillac; this car screams luxury but needs an upgrade; with Shane giving the MBC team creative freedom on the build, Joe gets to work on a plan; new engine, new wheels and a new interior.

title: Iron Resurrection
description: Return customer Lee Farris comes to Martin Bros with a 1956 Chevy Bel Air, his first car that he wants to bring back to life; the first thing Joe notices is the outdated flame paint job.

title: Iron Resurrection
description: Joe Martin loves to push the limits; when a customer rolls into the shop with a 1950 Mercury Coupe, Joe Martin knows he needs to chop the top.

title: Iron Resurrection
description: With the 1950 Mercury successfully chopped, the rest of the work can begin; the MBC team now has to marry the old roof with the new geometry of the newly chopped body; there are angles everywhere, and they are all out of whack.

title: Iron Resurrection
description: Joe Martin gets some unusual cars coming through the door of his work shop, but when a customer from California arrives with a '63 Rambler wagon and tells Joe he can do what he wants with it, he decides to go to town with a radical custom job.

title: Iron Resurrection
description: Joe Martin loves Novas and his eyes light up when a new customer, Eric, wants him to customize a 1972 as a tribute to his brother, if they can find one; Shag and Amanda hunt down a '71, in what appears to be mint condition.

title: Iron Resurrection
description: Joe Martin and his crew are always under the gun, but their latest build, a '71 Nova, is well behind schedule, and they have a ton of work to do; Joe is really going to town on the metal work on this car, inside and out.

title: Head 2 Head
description: The guys take another crack at a 50-year-old question: Mustang or Camaro?

title: Head 2 Head
description: Two of the toughest off-road trucks available duke it out in the desert.

title: Head 2 Head
description: Jonny and Jethro take a look at two of the best German sports cars ever.

title: Head 2 Head
description: One Cali-built custom Porsche 911 is a dancer, the other a sledgehammer.

title: Head 2 Head
description: Jethro brings Jonny to the UK for a British sports car baptism by fire.

title: Head 2 Head
description: The guys check out fast German station wagons from Mercedes and Porsche.

title: Head 2 Head
description: The guys check out two cars that are part sports car, part supercar.

title: Head 2 Head
description: The guys pit Chevy's and Dodge's modern-day muscle cars against each other.

title: Head 2 Head
description: Jethro and Jonny examine the Audi TT RS and the Porsche 718 Cayman GTS.

title: Head 2 Head
description: Jonny and Jethro drive from LA to Las Vegas in a Jaguar and a Maserati.

title: Head 2 Head
description: Jonny and Jethro visit the nearly 800 horsepower club. The Ferrari 812 Superfast and Dodge Challenger Hellcat Redeye might seem worlds apart on paper, but they are only separated by eight horsepower.

title: Head 2 Head
description: The 2019 McLaren 600LT faces off against the 2019 Porsche GT3 RS.

title: Head 2 Head
description: Jethro and Jonny pit BMW's mighty M2 against the ultralight Alpine A110.

title: Head 2 Head
description: Jonny and Jethro look at two of the last true hardcore production SUVs.

title: Head 2 Head
description: The Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio is up against the Jaguar Project 8.

title: Head 2 Head
description: The MAT New Stratos and Superformance GT40 have one foot in the past.

title: Head 2 Head
description: Jonny and Jethro live out their touring fantasies in two British beasts.

title: Head 2 Head
description: The guys pit the legendary Shelby GT350 against the new Toyota Supra.

title: Head 2 Head
description: The 2019 Honda Civic Type R does battle with the 2020 Hyundai Veloster N.

title: Head 2 Head
description: The '19 Camaro ZL1 1LE goes up against the 2020 Lotus Evora.

title: Head 2 Head
description: Jonny and Jethro drive the BMW M5 Competition and the Mercedes-AMG GT 63 S.

title: Bitchin' Rides
description: Dave and the crew start on a 1966 Corvette, but his client doesn't want the color to be anywhere close to its original green.

title: Bitchin' Rides
description: Dave comes up with a shade of green that finally gets the client on board.

title: Bitchin' Rides
description: A past client returns with a 1965 Mustang Fastback, and though he likes the stock look, he wants to upgrade the drivetrain, instrumentation and as many modern amenities as possible; the assembly team gets a crash course in engine tuning.

title: Bitchin' Rides
description: The crew strives to finish an active-duty serviceman's '51 Ford pickup.
